calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-03-2011 Off Calendar

Osc For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Nov-03-2011 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on as an Add on to the regularly scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name (due to clerical error by ACCESS center and was heard by the Court at 2:30 p.m.)
Dept. 514, Judge: Tomar Mason, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, NOT REPORTED.

Petitioner Margarita Elia Butler aka Margarite Elis Villalta was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Margarita Villalta Molina.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
